requirements: Projects have members (project_members). Members see the tasks of their projects and may add tasks to them. A task may be assigned to a user, who need not be a member of the project; only the assignee may update a task, and may move it to any project; the task keeps its assignee. Nobody deletes tasks.
expected_properties: Tasks are only seen, added and changed by members of their project.
Only the assignee updates a task.
Leaving a project never grants access.
An assignee is always a member of the task's project.
Whatever is written can be read back.
The application role may only select/insert/update tasks and select project_members.
A member can read the tasks of their projects.
A member can add an unassigned task to their project.
An assignee can mark their task done.
